description: Nitro 3 comes out as betas whose patch number is the release date (3.0.260903-beta), and each one is tagged latest on npm.
By default Renovate offers a prerelease only with the same major.minor.patch as the current version, so it offers none of the later betas, only a stable release.
While package.json pins a Nitro 3 prerelease, this also offers the newer prereleases, up to the one tagged latest. From a stable version on, the defaults apply again.
